name: Turbulent Flow Autoregressive Diffusion Benchmark
description: An evaluation suite for autoregressive conditional diffusion models measuring their ability to simulate and forecast turbulent flow dynamics, emphasizing temporal accuracy and physical consistency.
evaluation_method: RMSE / MSE (and normalized RMSE) on predicted fields; spectral (energy) error; temporal rollout accuracy; physics-consistency checks (e.g., divergence, conservation)
general_score_metric: Normalized RMSE (L2) over spatio-temporal fields and spectral similarity (energy spectrum error)
reputation: Emerging benchmark used within the ML-for-physics and CFD research community; adoption is growing but still niche.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark with high computational cost; results sensitive to numerical resolution and simulation settings; multiple heterogeneous (statistical + physics) metrics complicate direct comparisons; datasets tend to be large.
